title: decision-api: versioned NIP-CJ decision jobs with bounded worker admission
body:
<!-- openagents-project-triage:start -->
## Project triage

Project: [Decision Router](https://github.com/orgs/OpenAgentsInc/projects/15) · Workstream: Relay transport · Priority: P2 · Readiness: Ready.

Parent tracker: #9481.

Landed prerequisites retained as native dependency links: #9474, #9467.

Use the landed key/principal and execution-receipt contracts from #9466/#9471. The worker can be implemented independently of the HTTP gateway. Coordinate #9484 only for durable long-running jobs; ordinary relay delivery does not require the durable-job product.

<!-- openagents-project-triage:end -->

---

Spec: `docs/decision-models/decision-api.md`. Define a decision-job payload carrying a `/v1/systemone` request and a worker that fronts the existing Rust serving path.

The relay supplies authenticated encrypted transport; it does not itself allocate model capacity, settle tenant usage, or retain durable job state.

## Acceptance

- [x] Update the OpenAgents NIP specification first, with explicit payload/version discrimination from existing Coder jobs, supported-version behavior, and protocol fixtures. Decide whether an extension or a distinct kind is required rather than silently reinterpreting an existing payload.
- [x] Validate signatures, expected worker/customer identities, and request/result correlation; preserve NIP-44 encryption and the existing NIP-42 relay authentication boundary.
- [x] Use the same tenant authorization, artifact binding, quota, and receipt semantics as the HTTP path: #9466, #9467, #9474, and #9471.
- [x] Bound worker admission and pending work, report capacity refusals explicitly, and honor contact/answer deadlines and cancellation policy without model fallback.
- [x] Specify replay/retry behavior and durable ownership for request/attempt state. Ephemeral relay events are not a durable queue or evidence of exactly-once completion.
- [x] Preserve actual artifact/execution identity and transport/timing metadata in results, including refusal and upstream-failure cases.
- [x] Verify a successful typed answer plus absent worker, busy worker, upstream failure, duplicate/replayed request, wrong signer/correlation, unsupported version, and interrupted connection cases.

The HTTP gateway and Phase 0 pilot can ship before this lane. Relay discovery is #9470. Preserve existing Coder job compatibility and follow the repository's Nostr skill and spec-first workflow.

## Expanded product integration

- [ ] Define how decision payloads reference the canonical classification/native schemas and policies without freezing an incompatible second API. Preserve existing Coder payload/version behavior.
- [ ] Share model/capacity limits with #9483/#9486 and request/attempt/item identity with #9471. A relay retry cannot bypass quota or commercial holds.
- [ ] Use #9484 for durable long-running ownership, progress, cancellation, and result retention when jobs require them. Keep relay event delivery distinct from that storage contract.
- [ ] Include signed/relayed report-commitment publication only under an explicit authenticated envelope and trust policy; do not confuse it with remote execution attestation.
